source_statement: A circle of radius t is tangent to the hypotenuse, the incircle, and one leg of an isosceles right triangle with inradius r = 1 + sin π8 . Find rt.

clause_ledger.dsl: right-isosceles gauge with legs on x=0 and y=0 and hypotenuse x+y=L
I=(r,r) and the source radius is fixed directly

clause_ledger.source: small circle radius t tangent to one leg and the hypotenuse
clause_ledger.dsl: T=(L-t(1+sqrt(2)),t), so y=t and distance to x+y=L is t

clause_ledger.source: small circle tangent to the incircle
